about_the_game:
Dual-Wield Destruction

Dual-wield devastating weapon combos and surge with momentum in a Roguelite FPS where every upgrade stacks and time itself becomes your weapon.

Move Like a Missile

Dodge a constant barrage of enemy projectiles with deft movement and timed parries. Chain grapples, slides, wallruns, and railgrinds to build momentum, then unleash firepower while in motion for furious damage. Move fast, hit hard, and survive in style.

Reaper Mode Execution

Rack up kills to activate Reaper Mode — pause time, wreak havoc, then unpause reality to shatter clusters of foes in a single moment.

Craft Overpowered Builds

Slot attachments into weapons on a hex grid where placement matters. Turn shotguns into flamethrowers or bananas into nukes. Rearrange anytime to maximize elemental effects, discover wild synergies, and completely change how you fight mid-run.

Die with Purpose

Each run is a new configuration of chaos — new weapon combos, new enemy encounters, and new ways to break the game. Every death builds upon the last, earning permanent upgrades at the end of each run.

Rewrite a Broken Future

Destroy the architects of endless brutality in a blood-curdling odyssey through underground prisons, cyberpunk cityscapes, and into the great beyond to settle the score. Turn the tables on the wealthy warlords who made you into a killing machine.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 Dual-Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1350 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 Dual-Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1350 MB available space
